---
name: Bug / 再現可能な不具合
about: Report a failure using synthetic data only
---

## Version / environment
Commit, OS, Python, dependency lock. Do not include local usernames or paths.

## Reproduction
Use synthetic fixtures and exact commands; no real invoices, salary data,
API tokens, office/folder IDs, customer names or unredacted screenshots/logs.

## Expected vs observed
Expected journal lines, amounts/tax, status or replay count; actual sanitized result.
State OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC or authorized live observation. Do not paste API responses.

## Recovery / duplicate effects
Did the same input/run get replayed? Were extra writes observed? Unknown is unknown.

## Privacy check
- [ ] No real company, personal, credential or accounting data is included.
